title: Equal Tree Partition
description:
Given the root of a binary tree, return true if you can partition the tree into two trees with equal sums of values after removing exactly one edge on the original tree . 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/05/03/split1-tree.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [5,10,10,null,null,2,3]

Output:
 true
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/05/03/split2-tree.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [1,2,10,null,null,2,20]

Output:
 false

Explanation:
 You cannot split the tree into two trees with equal sums after removing exactly one edge on the tree.
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 10 4 ] . 
 
 -10 5 <= Node.val <= 10 5
